ScientificClaim.claimText: 20 mRNAs are differentially expressed in breast cancer tissue.

RationaleArtifact.rationaleText: The claim is based on the identification of 20 mRNAs with AUC ≥ 0.9 and p < 0.0001 from ROC curve analysis.
RationaleArtifact.keyEvidenceSummary: These mRNAs were identified as significantly differentially expressed at -log10(p) > 3 in both the 526 vs. 60 and the paired 60 vs. 60 comparisons.
uncertainties: The claim does not specify whether these mRNAs are up- or down-regulated.
The study did not investigate the biological context of these findings.
